subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should Usage & Spend ship as a permanent dedicated Settings pane, or should its model and presentation be integrated into the existing Overview surface?
rationale: This introduces a substantial permanent product surface with privacy-sensitive local history behavior, and the contributor explicitly requested the repository owner's placement decision.

options.title: Keep dedicated pane
options.body: Ship the focused Usage & Spend destination after repairing the disabled-state file-access defect and validating shared history compatibility.

options.title: Integrate into Overview
options.body: Reuse the dashboard model in the existing Overview and remove the new sidebar destination before merge.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers agree on a narrower product and maintenance boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep dedicated pane
recommendation.body: Ship the focused Usage & Spend destination after repairing the disabled-state file-access defect and validating shared history compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the repository, authored the current rewrite, and was explicitly asked to decide the product placement.
